lines: #The month is over. Before the next one starts, do *this.*
What did you spend on that you don't even *remember?*
Then ask, did this make my life *better?*
So they make the same mistakes month after *month.*
#Ten minutes of looking can save you *hundreds.*
#Then pick one thing to change for *December.*
Move a little more into savings the day you get *paid.*
By next year, you won't *recognise* your account.
#Close out the month like a *business* owner.
Because your life is the most important business you'll ever *run.*
end: Save this and do your money review tonight.
